title: Amaranthium (the hunt Ensues)
description: The Next Amaranthium Mod, mostly about Monster hunting, adds new Items called Emblems, that trigger effects when in the Inventory
body:
Amaranthium (The Hunt Ensues) Adds: wooden stakes, cross stakes, the stake slinger, shilling slinger, "Cross"-Bow, Silver Longsword, Holy Longsword, Holy Halberd, a Monster Hunter Armour set, Scimitar, Lodesword, THE FIRECRACKER, Jest Emblem, Boom Emblem, Squid Emblem, Glow Squid Emblem, Rotten Emblem, Boney Emblem, Web Emblem, Dark Web Emblem, Emerald Battle Fan, Ripened Waraxe, and the Blazing sword. there are also Items to reference Mods on the Content SMP, As I Am A HUGE Fan, these are: Amethyst Pike, Copperum Tank, Copperum Tank (Ammo), the Inkwell, and the Cleaver.
There is also a "Dodge" Keybind, which sends you in a random direction to help dodge attacks, (it has a 10 second cooldown) the default "Dodge" keybind is "R" and holding different items in your hand (Or wearing monster hunter armour) have different effects and priorities for these effects.

Anyone who wants to make an addon for this mod can if they wish.
